Number of tuples obtained by applying cartesian product over X and Y are :
solution:
The Cartesian product is a set formed from two
or more given sets and contains all ordered pairs
of elements such that the first element of the
pair is from the first set the second is from the
second set, and so on.
There are 4 tuples from the left outer join and 4
from the right outer join, So Number of tuples
obtained by applying cartesian product over X
and Y will be 4x4 =16.
So option A is the correct answer.
